about_the_game:
BECOME AN ACE OF THE SKIES IN YOUR OWN BACKYARD!

TURN YOUR HOME INTO A BATTLEFIELD

Ever wondered what would happen if your lovingly assembled model airplanes suddenly came to life?

Battle of Back Yard is a multiplayer game packed with fast-paced aerial dogfights that break out right next door. Fulfill your childhood dreams: take off straight from the couch, seize control of the backyard skies, and obliterate that pesky enemy rascal with a missile you found in the breadbox. Full throttle, no mercy!

A BOMB DOESN’T FALL FAR FROM THE BOMBER

You take off and—bang—you’re under fire immediately. You barrel roll, try to shake the tail, pull straight up toward the blue ceiling… then bounce back and charge head-on!

Your field of view snaps tight, adrenaline floods your temples as the engine’s roar blends with the dry rattle of machine guns. It’s just you now—you and your plastic nemesis. A pure game of chicken. Tracer rounds slice the air right in front of the cockpit. Unfortunately for you, some of them hit their mark…

With your burning model pushed to the very edge of its limits, you kiss any hope of victory goodbye—when suddenly you spot it. The thing everyone’s been looking for: the Magic Piñata!

NO PAIN NO PLANE

Explosive homing rubber ducks, eye‑searing lasers, rockets, bombs, mines, supply crates, stinky cheese, or Dad’s revolver. Oh… yeah.

Hunt down the arsenal scattered all over the house before anyone else does—and use it to blast your way to victory.

HOME WASN’T BUILD IN A DAY

Already had fun on our maps? Want more? In the immortal words of John F. Kennedy: “Ask not what your game can do for you—ask what you can do for your game.” Enter our level editor and take control. The world is yours… well, at least the part fenced in around your house and backyard.).

Unleash your creativity: dive into the map editor and craft your own campaign or battlefield! Rearrange the furniture, move the bed into the garden, or turn the house upside down! Set up a couch fort in the living room, or hop into the fridge and station an anti-air cannon between the ham and cheese! Surprise us—and the other players!

HE WHO HOSTS, NEVER GETS LOST

Team up with your friends and fight on your own terms — turn your PC into a mobile command base and host your very own server! Tap into the mysterious power of the “double pear” maneuver (peer‑to‑peer) and become the master of your own fate.

Kitchen base, do you copy?

This is Admiral Al B. Back, over.

We can’t launch without you! Over and out.

short_description: Engage in thrilling household air battles in this wacky game. Choose your role as a skilled pilot or a sharp-shooting gunner, and customize your aircraft to fit your preferred playstyle. Take on daring missions or challenge friends in multiplayer combat. Relive history and dominate the skies!

English*, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
